item.name: Gulabite
item.description: Gulabite is a legendary ore with an excellent 9.99x multiplier. A pure stat-boosting ore with no special effects.

item.description: Coinite is a legendary ore with a unique property - while it only has a 1x crafting multiplier, it sells for 15x the normal value, making it ideal for profit.

item.name: Duranite
item.description: Duranite is a mythical ore with an impressive 12x multiplier. Its unique trait provides +7.5% Durability when used in armor crafting.

item.name: Evil Eye
item.description: Evil Eye is a mythical ore with an excellent 13.3x multiplier. A pure stat-boosting ore with no special effects.

item.name: Yeti Heart
item.description: Yeti Heart is a mythical ore with a 7.7x multiplier. Its unique trait provides 30% Crit Chance, 10% Crit DMG, and 10% Attack Speed when used in weapon crafting.

item.name: Stolen Heart
item.description: Stolen Heart is a relic ore with an outstanding 15.4x multiplier. Its unique trait provides 20% chance for 3% lifesteal per hit when used in armor crafting.

item.name: Golem Heart

item.name: Heart of The Island
item.description: Heart Of The Island is a relic ore with the highest multiplier in Raven's Cave at 18.5x. Its unique trait provides +30% Vitality and heals 50% HP when below 20% (2 min cooldown).

item.name: Mistvein
item.rocks: Small Ice Crystal, Medium Ice Crystal, Large Ice Crystal, Floating Crystal

item.name: Lgarite

item.description: Jagged and oddly refined at the same time. Looks artificial, but no one remembers making it.

item.name: Voidfractal
item.rocks: Small Ice Crystal, Medium Ice Crystal, Large Ice Crystal, Floating Crystal

item.name: Moltenfrost

item.description: Burns and freezes at the same time. Physics gave up trying to explain this one.

item.name: Malachite

item.description: Dense, oversized, and brutally heavy. It takes effort just to remind it who's holding the pickaxe.

item.name: Mosasaursit

item.name: Galaxite
